changelog:
QuickView pre-release v6.29.0.0

- feat(ui): add Windows 11 native Mica effect for window and context menu backdrops (#219)
- feat(settings): add custom left-double-click functionality (#219)
- feat(filmstrip): add trigger height, dwell time, exit delay configs 
- feat(ui): add KeepGalleryVisibleOnThumbnailClick setting 
- feat(compare): disable edge indicators in compare mode and adapt selection indicator (#223)
- feat(settings): add double-click dropdown mode & minimap hover wheel panning (#219, #224)
- fix: restore explorer view sort order sync via shell COM (#233) 
- fix(minimap): resolve full length display and click navigation offset for ultra-long/wide images
- Fix giant 16-bit TIFF loading and rendering
- Fix(#221): Resolve Titan mode missing chunks and high CPU usage via fail count reset & cascaded downsampling
- fix(gallery): refactor D2D device resource lifecycle and fix slideshow mode crash 
- fix(svg): unify baseFit zoom calculations for small SVG initial size and scaling (#219)
- style(gallery): refine filmstrip margins, slim navigation arrows, and pin button size (#144)
- fix(ui): hide gallery hotspot when settings or help overlay is visible
- chore(deps): upgrade all third-party dependencies and lock libjxl to v0.12.0 (#288)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/compare/v6.26.1.0...v6.29.0.0
